meta.purpose: Searchable formula database. Each entry names its source chapter so the derivation can be revised in context.

formulas.name: Prime cost
formulas.expression: Direct material consumed + Direct wages + Direct expenses
formulas.note: Direct material consumed = opening stock + purchases − closing stock.

formulas.name: Works (factory) cost
formulas.expression: Prime cost + Factory overheads + Opening WIP − Closing WIP
formulas.note: Adjust for WIP before adding administration overheads.

formulas.name: Cost of sales
formulas.expression: Cost of production + Selling and distribution overheads + Opening finished goods − Closing finished goods
formulas.note: The last line before profit.

formulas.name: Economic order quantity
formulas.expression: EOQ = √(2 × A × O / C)
formulas.note: A = annual consumption, O = ordering cost per order, C = carrying cost per unit per year.

formulas.name: Economic batch quantity
formulas.note: d = demand rate, p = production rate.

formulas.name: Reorder level
formulas.expression: Maximum consumption × Maximum lead time
formulas.note: Triggers a fresh order.

formulas.name: Maximum stock level
formulas.expression: Reorder level + EOQ − (Minimum consumption × Minimum lead time)
formulas.note: Minimum level = ROL − (Normal consumption × Normal lead time).

formulas.name: Weighted average issue price
formulas.expression: Total cost of stock in hand / Total quantity in hand
formulas.note: Recomputed after every receipt.

formulas.name: Halsey premium plan
formulas.expression: Earnings = (Time taken × Rate) + 50% × (Time saved × Rate)
formulas.note: The 50% sharing ratio is the usual default.

formulas.name: Rowan premium plan
formulas.expression: Earnings = (Time taken × Rate) + (Time saved / Time allowed) × Time taken × Rate
formulas.note: Self-limiting as time saved approaches time allowed.

formulas.name: Machine hour rate
formulas.expression: (Fixed costs attributable to the machine + Variable running costs) / Machine hours
formulas.note: Standing charges divided by normal working hours.

formulas.name: Under / over absorption
formulas.expression: Absorbed overhead − Actual overhead
formulas.note: Positive = over-absorbed; negative = under-absorbed.

formulas.name: Labour turnover — replacement method
formulas.expression: (Replacements / Average number of workers) × 100
formulas.note: Preferred over the separation method for cost analysis.

formulas.name: Normal process cost per unit
formulas.expression: (Total process cost − Scrap value of normal loss) / (Input units − Normal loss units)
formulas.note: Basis for valuing abnormal loss and gain.

formulas.name: Equivalent production
formulas.expression: Units completed + (Closing WIP × Degree of completion)
formulas.note: Add normal loss only where it is fully complete.

formulas.name: Inter-process profit reserve
formulas.expression: (Transfer price − Cost per unit) × Units in closing stock
formulas.note: Eliminates unrealised internal profit.

formulas.name: Notional profit on a contract
formulas.expression: Work certified + Work uncertified − Cost incurred to date
formulas.note: Then apply the 1/3 or 2/3 recognition rule.

formulas.name: Profit to be transferred — 25% to 50% complete
formulas.expression: Notional profit × 1/3 × (Cash received / Work certified)
formulas.note: Above 50%, use 2/3 instead of 1/3.

formulas.name: Operating cost per composite unit
formulas.expression: Total operating cost / (Units carried × Distance)
formulas.note: For example, cost per tonne-km or passenger-km.

formulas.name: Learning curve average time
formulas.expression: Average time for 2n units = Average time for n units × Learning rate
formulas.note: Total time = cumulative average × cumulative units.

formulas.name: Contribution
formulas.expression: Sales − Variable cost = Fixed cost + Profit
formulas.note: The core identity of marginal costing.

formulas.name: P/V ratio
formulas.expression: Contribution / Sales × 100
formulas.note: Also = (Change in contribution / Change in sales) × 100.

formulas.name: Break-even point in units
formulas.expression: Fixed cost / Contribution per unit
formulas.note: Break-even value = Fixed cost / P/V ratio.

formulas.name: Margin of safety
formulas.expression: Actual sales − Break-even sales
formulas.note: Profit = Margin of safety × P/V ratio.

formulas.name: Sales required for a target profit
formulas.expression: (Fixed cost + Target profit) / P/V ratio
formulas.note: Use contribution per unit for a unit answer.

formulas.name: Contribution per limiting factor
formulas.expression: Contribution per unit / Units of the scarce resource per unit
formulas.note: Rank by this, never by contribution per unit.

formulas.name: Relevant cost of making
formulas.expression: Variable cost of manufacture + Opportunity cost of the capacity used
formulas.note: Exclude unavoidable allocated fixed costs.

formulas.name: Minimum transfer price
formulas.expression: Incremental cost + Opportunity cost per unit
formulas.note: Zero opportunity cost when spare capacity exists.

formulas.name: Discontinuation test
formulas.expression: Continue if Contribution > Avoidable fixed costs
formulas.note: Allocated common costs are not avoidable.

formulas.name: Absorption vs marginal profit difference
formulas.expression: Fixed overhead in closing stock − Fixed overhead in opening stock
formulas.note: Positive means absorption profit is higher.

formulas.name: Sell or process further
formulas.expression: Process further if Incremental revenue > Incremental cost of further processing
formulas.note: Joint costs up to split-off are irrelevant.

formulas.name: Production budget
formulas.expression: Sales units + Closing finished goods − Opening finished goods
formulas.note: Drives material and labour budgets.

formulas.name: Material purchase budget
formulas.expression: Production requirement + Closing raw material − Opening raw material
formulas.note: Value at expected purchase price.

formulas.name: Flexed cost
formulas.expression: Fixed cost + (Variable rate × Actual activity)
formulas.note: Only variable costs flex within the relevant range.

formulas.name: Material cost variance
formulas.expression: (Standard quantity for actual output × Standard price) − (Actual quantity × Actual price)
formulas.note: = Price variance + Usage variance.

formulas.name: Material price variance
formulas.expression: (Standard price − Actual price) × Actual quantity purchased
formulas.note: State whether the quantity basis is purchases or usage.

formulas.name: Material usage variance
formulas.expression: (Standard quantity for actual output − Actual quantity) × Standard price
formulas.note: Favourable when less material is used.

formulas.name: Material mix variance
formulas.expression: (Revised standard quantity − Actual quantity) × Standard price
formulas.note: Revised quantity = total actual quantity × standard mix proportion.

formulas.name: Labour rate variance
formulas.expression: (Standard rate − Actual rate) × Actual hours
formulas.note: Usually a wage negotiation or grade-mix issue.

formulas.name: Labour efficiency variance
formulas.expression: (Standard hours for actual output − Actual hours) × Standard rate
formulas.note: Operational responsibility.

formulas.name: Fixed overhead volume variance
formulas.expression: Absorbed fixed overhead − Budgeted fixed overhead
formulas.note: Splits into capacity and efficiency components.

formulas.name: Sales margin volume variance
formulas.expression: (Actual quantity − Budgeted quantity) × Standard margin per unit
formulas.note: Use margin, not price, when costs change.

formulas.name: Future value
formulas.expression: FV = PV × (1 + r)^n
formulas.note: Compounding.

formulas.name: Present value
formulas.expression: PV = FV / (1 + r)^n
formulas.note: The basis of every DCF calculation.

formulas.name: Present value of an annuity
formulas.note: Use the annuity factor for level cash flows.

formulas.name: Net present value
formulas.expression: NPV = Σ CFt / (1 + k)^t − Initial outlay
formulas.note: Accept if positive.

formulas.name: Profitability index
formulas.expression: PV of cash inflows / Initial investment
formulas.note: Rank under capital rationing.

formulas.name: IRR (interpolation)
formulas.expression: IRR = L + [NPV at L / (NPV at L − NPV at H)] × (H − L)
formulas.note: L and H are the lower and higher trial rates.

formulas.name: Payback period
formulas.expression: Years before recovery + (Unrecovered amount / Cash flow in the recovery year)
formulas.note: A liquidity measure, not a value measure.

formulas.name: Weighted average cost of capital
formulas.note: Use market-value weights where available.

formulas.name: CAPM cost of equity
formulas.expression: Ke = Rf + β × (Rm − Rf)
formulas.note: Beta measures systematic risk.

formulas.name: Degree of operating leverage
formulas.expression: Contribution / EBIT
formulas.note: Sensitivity of EBIT to sales.

formulas.name: Degree of financial leverage
formulas.expression: EBIT / (EBIT − Interest)
formulas.note: Sensitivity of EPS to EBIT.

formulas.name: Current ratio
formulas.expression: Current assets / Current liabilities
formulas.note: Benchmark is industry-specific.

formulas.name: Quick ratio
formulas.expression: (Current assets − Inventory − Prepaid expenses) / Current liabilities
formulas.note: A stricter liquidity test.

formulas.name: Operating cycle
formulas.expression: Inventory days + Receivable days − Payable days
formulas.note: Also called the cash conversion cycle.

formulas.name: Return on capital employed
formulas.expression: EBIT / (Total assets − Current liabilities) × 100
formulas.note: Before financing decisions.

formulas.name: DuPont decomposition
formulas.expression: ROE = (PAT / Sales) × (Sales / Assets) × (Assets / Equity)
formulas.note: Margin × turnover × leverage.

formulas.name: Baumol optimal cash balance
formulas.expression: √(2 × Annual cash requirement × Transaction cost / Opportunity cost rate)
formulas.note: Assumes predictable cash flows.

formulas.name: Divisional ROI
formulas.expression: Divisional profit / Divisional investment × 100
formulas.note: Can cause under-investment.

formulas.name: Residual income
formulas.expression: Divisional profit − (Required rate × Investment)
formulas.note: Aligns with value creation.

formulas.name: Economic value added
formulas.expression: NOPAT − (WACC × Capital employed)
formulas.note: Economic profit after a capital charge.

formulas.name: Two-asset portfolio risk
formulas.expression: σp = √(w1²σ1² + w2²σ2² + 2w1w2ρσ1σ2)
formulas.note: Correlation drives diversification benefit.

formulas.name: Sharpe ratio
formulas.expression: (Rp − Rf) / σp
formulas.note: Excess return per unit of total risk.

formulas.name: Treynor ratio
formulas.expression: (Rp − Rf) / βp
formulas.note: Excess return per unit of systematic risk.

formulas.name: Jensen's alpha
formulas.expression: Rp − [Rf + β(Rm − Rf)]
formulas.note: Outperformance after adjusting for beta.

formulas.name: Project crashing cost slope
formulas.expression: (Crash cost − Normal cost) / (Normal time − Crash time)
formulas.note: Crash the lowest-cost critical activity first.

formulas.name: Earned value indices
formulas.expression: CPI = EV / AC; SPI = EV / PV
formulas.note: Below 1 means over budget or behind schedule.

formulas.name: Operating cash flow (indirect)
formulas.expression: PBT + Depreciation ± Working capital changes − Tax paid
formulas.note: Add back non-cash charges and finance costs consistently.

formulas.name: Goodwill under Ind AS 103
formulas.expression: Consideration + NCI + Previously held interest − Fair value of net identifiable assets
formulas.note: If negative after reassessment, a bargain purchase gain.

formulas.name: Non-controlling interest at reporting date
formulas.expression: NCI at acquisition + NCI share of post-acquisition profits and OCI − NCI dividends
formulas.note: Proportionate-share method.

formulas.name: Goodwill — super profit method
formulas.expression: (Average profit − Normal profit) × Years of purchase
formulas.note: Normal profit = Capital employed × normal rate.

formulas.name: Goodwill — capitalisation of super profit
formulas.expression: Super profit / Normal rate of return
formulas.note: Expresses goodwill as capitalised excess earnings.

formulas.name: DCF enterprise value
formulas.expression: EV = Σ FCFFt / (1 + WACC)^t + Terminal value / (1 + WACC)^n
formulas.note: Terminal value via Gordon growth or exit multiple.

formulas.name: Gordon growth terminal value
formulas.expression: TV = FCFF(n+1) / (WACC − g)
formulas.note: g must be below the growth rate of the economy.

formulas.name: Value per share — earnings capitalisation
formulas.expression: Value = EPS × P/E multiple
formulas.note: Use a comparable-company multiple.

formulas.name: Target cost
formulas.expression: Target selling price − Target profit margin
formulas.note: Cost gap = current estimated cost − target cost.

formulas.name: HRA exemption
formulas.expression: Least of: actual HRA; rent paid − 10% of salary; 50%/40% of salary
formulas.note: 50% for the four metro cities. Not available under the new regime.

formulas.name: Gratuity exemption
formulas.expression: Least of ₹20,00,000; actual gratuity; (15/26) × salary × completed years
formulas.note: Lifetime cap across employers.

formulas.name: Income from house property
formulas.expression: Annual value − Municipal taxes paid by owner − 30% of NAV − Interest on borrowed capital
formulas.note: The 30% deduction is statutory, not actual.

formulas.name: Long-term capital gain (with indexation where applicable)
formulas.expression: Sale consideration − Indexed cost of acquisition − Indexed cost of improvement − Transfer expenses
formulas.note: Indexation has been withdrawn for most assets for transfers on or after 23 July 2024; check the transitional rules.

formulas.name: Indexed cost of acquisition
formulas.expression: Cost × CII (year of transfer) / CII (year of acquisition)
formulas.note: Use the notified CII table.

formulas.name: Section 54 exemption
formulas.expression: LTCG × Amount invested / Sale consideration
formulas.note: Subject to the statutory investment cap.

formulas.name: Presumptive business income
formulas.expression: 8% of turnover (6% for receipts through prescribed electronic modes)
formulas.note: No separate expense or depreciation deduction.

formulas.name: Value of supply
formulas.expression: Transaction price + non-GST taxes + incidental expenses + subsidies (other than government) + interest/late fees − eligible discounts
formulas.note: Post-supply discounts require a contractual linkage.

formulas.name: Net GST payable
formulas.expression: Output tax − Eligible input tax credit
formulas.note: IGST credit can be used against CGST and SGST; CGST and SGST cannot cross-utilise.

formulas.name: Rule 42 common credit reversal
formulas.expression: Reversal = Total ITC × (Exempt + non-business turnover / Total turnover)
formulas.note: Computed monthly and annualised.

formulas.name: Customs assessable value
formulas.expression: FOB value + freight + insurance
formulas.note: Insurance commonly taken at 1.125% of FOB where not ascertainable.

formulas.name: Total import duty
formulas.expression: BCD = AV × rate; SWS = 10% × BCD; IGST = (AV + BCD + SWS) × rate
formulas.note: Only the IGST component is creditable.

formulas.name: Duty drawback on re-export
formulas.expression: 98% of duty paid on goods re-exported as such
formulas.note: Section 74.

formulas.name: Monthly EPF contribution
formulas.expression: Employee 12% of PF wages; employer 12% split into EPS 8.33% (capped) and the balance to EPF
formulas.note: Verify current ceilings and administrative charges.

formulas.name: Coefficient of variation
formulas.expression: (Standard deviation / Mean) × 100
formulas.note: Compare consistency across datasets with different means.

formulas.name: Combined mean
formulas.note: For merged groups.

formulas.name: Karl Pearson correlation
formulas.expression: r = Σ(x−x̄)(y−ȳ) / √(Σ(x−x̄)² Σ(y−ȳ)²)
formulas.note: Range −1 to +1; r² is the coefficient of determination.

formulas.name: Regression slope
formulas.expression: b = Σ(x−x̄)(y−ȳ) / Σ(x−x̄)²
formulas.note: Y = a + bX.

formulas.name: Price elasticity of demand
formulas.expression: (% change in quantity demanded) / (% change in price)
formulas.note: |Ed| > 1 is elastic; revenue moves opposite to price.

formulas.name: Marginal revenue and elasticity
formulas.note: MR = 0 at unit elasticity.

formulas.name: PERT expected time
formulas.expression: te = (O + 4M + P) / 6; variance = ((P − O)/6)²
formulas.note: Probabilistic project duration.

formulas.name: Total float
formulas.expression: LFT − EFT = LST − EST
formulas.note: Zero on the critical path.

formulas.name: Cost of goods sold
formulas.expression: Opening stock + Purchases + Direct expenses − Closing stock
formulas.note: Gross profit = Net sales − COGS.

formulas.name: Managerial commission after charging
formulas.expression: (Profit before commission × Rate) / (1 + Rate)
formulas.note: Use the gross-up when the commission is a percentage of profit after itself.

formulas.name: Subscription income for the year
formulas.expression: Received + Closing outstanding − Opening outstanding − Closing advance + Opening advance
formulas.note: Converts cash receipts to accrual income.

formulas.name: Profit from capital movement
formulas.expression: Closing capital + Drawings − Fresh capital − Opening capital
formulas.note: For incomplete records.

formulas.name: Sacrificing ratio
formulas.expression: Old share − New share
formulas.note: Distributes the incoming partner's goodwill.

formulas.name: Gaining ratio
formulas.expression: New share − Old share
formulas.note: Continuing partners compensate the retiring partner.

formulas.name: Average clause claim
formulas.expression: Loss × (Sum insured / Value of stock on the date of loss)
formulas.note: Under-insurance reduces the claim proportionately.

formulas.name: Lease liability at inception
formulas.expression: PV of minimum lease payments + PV of guaranteed residual value, discounted at the implicit rate
formulas.note: Capitalise the lower of this and fair value.

formulas.name: Lease interest and principal split
formulas.expression: Interest = Outstanding liability × Implicit rate; Principal = Payment − Interest
formulas.note: Actuarial allocation each period.

formulas.name: CSR obligation
formulas.expression: 2% of average net profits of the immediately preceding three financial years
formulas.note: Applies above the prescribed net worth, turnover or profit thresholds.

formulas.name: Audit risk model
formulas.expression: Audit risk = Inherent risk × Control risk × Detection risk
formulas.note: Higher IR and CR require lower DR.
